column1: # K03 S1 census (K03-UNIFIED-HEAD-IMPLEMENT-20261006-01): every site of dev/l2src_sandbox/l2trans.lm1 that compares
# a head, an atom or a text with a word -- l2_frame_head(node, "w"), l2_text_eq(x, "w"), l2_payload_eq(x, "w") --
# with its function's class and the K03 slice that migrates it (- : not on the application-head route).
# Classes: stmt / name / value / call / def / merge (the route); set (the defined words); contract (a receiver's own
# contract, chosen after resolution); boundary (P0 trailers); descriptive (signatures, throws); lexical (operators,
# type words, paths, indices, addresses); file (predef, library, profile).  Line numbers are of the committed S1 bytes.
